purpose: Recent detail and two compressed views of history
alt:
Main network: Token embeddings → Hybrid attention → Expert FFN → Prediction head; Attention and FFN update four residual streams through mHC; repeat across 43 blocks.
CSA layers: Older history → Overlapping pooling → Sparse read; Attention combines selected global entries with the local 128-token window.
HCA layers: Older history → Coarse pooling → Dense compressed read; No top-k indexer. The same local window preserves recent detail.
caption: **Figure 1.** Recent detail and two compressed views of history. Original schematic based on the report and pinned release.[^report][^code]
